```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("ARC_Biomass_1982-2015.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Treatment, Species, Tissue, Average.g.m.2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Average.g.m.2)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, Species, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(biomass = sum(Average.g.m.2)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(biomass = sum(biomass)) 

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "ARC_Biomass_1982-2015_processed.csv")
```
